[[Arius' Sai]] are a set of [[unique item|unique]] [[daggers]] dropped by [[Arius, Dark Apostle]], a [[boss]] in [[Rhea's Crater]].
[[Image:Arius' Sai below.jpg|thumb|Lower view of the Arius' Sai]]

== Stats ==
: [[Piercing damage]]: 7-17 (Requires 9 [[Dagger Mastery]])
: [[Energy]] +5
: [[Armor penetration]] +20% (Chance: 20%)
: [[Enchantment Spell|Enchantments]] last 20% longer
